company.name: Therify
company.shortDescription: Therify provides an inclusive mental healthcare service for companies.
company.description: Therify provides inclusive mental health benefits for companies. Through Therify's web platform, employees can access culturally responsive therapists, live community sessions, and self-guided content to support their emotional well-being.

productsAndServices.description: A platform that matches employees with licensed, in-network therapists who accept their health insurance to facilitate faster access to mental healthcare and reduce costs.
productsAndServices.name: Therify In-Network Mental Health Platform

productsAndServices.description: A service to create a tailored network of in-network therapists suited to the specific needs of a company's employees and their families.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Provider Network Design

productsAndServices.description: A service providing dedicated Care Navigators who assist employees in finding and connecting with licensed therapists within their insurance network.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Care Navigation

productsAndServices.description: A process of selecting and verifying mental health providers to ensure quality and suitability within the in-network therapist group.
productsAndServices.name: Provider Vetting

productsAndServices.description: A consulting service to assess organizational wellbeing needs and design, implement, and monitor a tailored mental health program for employees.
productsAndServices.name: Custom Mental Health Program Design and Implementation

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $2,010,000, or 58.52% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $2,205,823 to $10,010,000, a 4.54x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 28 (-32 over 90 days) and market heat at 71 (-7).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Spring Health, TMV, Wysa.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
